utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can bring some screwdrivers and duct tape, and I’ll ask around for spare screws too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — that’s a big help. I’m still gathering tools and parts, and I’ll check with Rey and Dane too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’m on it, and I’ll let you know if I find any spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Right, Rosa — I heard Rey can help, and Cleo said we’re still short on screwdrivers, spare screws, and a few rolls of duct tape. Dane can bring a hammer, screwdrivers, and some spare nails too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Tess — I’ll keep sorting the names and addresses by street and urgency. Sunday at the community center is still the plan, and we’ll keep everyone in the loop as things come together.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great — I’ll pass that along, and I’ll keep an ear out for any more tools or supplies folks can spare.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still gathering a few things for the repair drive. If anything’s still missing, Noah said he can help with it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s great — we’re still short on tape, gloves, and a couple flashlights. Nell also wanted to help, so I’ll keep track of what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll keep looking and let Noah know we still need tape, gloves, and a couple flashlights.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help haul a few boxes and the small dresser. Let me know when and where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: The repair drive is at 9 at the community center — let’s meet there, and I’ll bring the donated tools over too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sounds good — I’ll meet you at the community center at 9. I’m glad Rey’s handling the tools and donations, so we can keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m running a bit late, but I can bring a hammer, screwdrivers, and some spare nails to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Dane—that’ll help a lot. We’re still set for 3 PM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll head to the community center and bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Rey’s helping with the repair drive, and Vik can bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and spare nails. Hana will confirm the drop-off time and check whether we still need extra boxes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ve got a screwdriver set and a roll of duct tape I can bring. Sounds like we’re almost set—just let me know if you still need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should cover most of it—thank you. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up before the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m waiting on Hana to lock in the drop-off spot and timing, then Quinn can pass the details along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’m still bringing the batteries and a box or two, and if anything’s missing, Noah can help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that covers it. Once Hana confirms the spot and time, Quinn can send it out and we’ll be set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll confirm the drop-off time and check whether we still need extra boxes. Kira, Vik, and Gus all sound set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything about the drill, step ladder, or extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — that would help a lot. I’ll still confirm the drop-off time and see whether we need any extra boxes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got my toolbox and a few screwdrivers here, and I’m still looking for tape and pliers for the repair drive. The tool table’s got things sorted out, so I can help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m out running errands, and I’ll keep an eye out for tape or pliers for the repair drive. If I spot any, I’ll bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — I’ll keep the tool table ready and watch for your update. Mara’s got 10 people lined up, so every extra tape roll or pair of pliers helps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll be there at 10 and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Rey — 10 works. I’ll pass Leo’s time and list fast, and I’ll line up a few neighbors to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Perfect, thanks, Quinn. See you at 10 — I’m glad you’re spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — Sam, send the new repair requests to Mara, and I’ll keep in touch with Mina while Eli helps with the hauling.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do — I’ll send the new repair requests to Mara now and keep Mina updated on our side.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll keep checking in with Mina while you send those over to Mara. Glad Eli’s on the hauling jobs too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — we still need a couple flashlights, screwdrivers, spare screws, and duct tape. I can help with whatever’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the repair drive is still at 9 at the community center? And if so, I think Nell already has the screwdrivers, duct tape, and spare screws covered.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it — then maybe we just need the flashlights now. And yes, I think it’s still at 9 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape and gloves ready for the repair drive. Bo said we still need screwdrivers, spare screws, and a few rolls of duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oren’s bringing a screwdriver set and duct tape, and he plans to be there at 10. Mara’s also keeping track of the volunteer sign-ups and what repairs people can handle.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, that covers a big chunk. I’ll keep an eye out for spare screws, and with you and Dane helping plus Nell wanting in, we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll check the community center for the donated tools and bring them over. See you at 9 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, 9 at the community center works for me. I’ve got the batteries and a box or two covered.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — I’ll be there at 9 and bring the donated tools over from the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still gathering a few things for the repair drive. If anything’s missing, Noah said he can help out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Uli — I’ll keep gathering the names and addresses by street and urgency. Sunday at the community center is still set, and I’ll let the others know we’re almost ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ve still got a few things to collect, but we’re getting close.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, that helps a lot — Rey, Dane, and Vik are all in, and Vik can bring the hammer, screwdrivers, and spare nails.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Brilliant — I’ve got my screwdriver set and duct tape ready, and I’ll pass Leo’s time and list along fast. Glad you can fit it around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep it all coordinated around school pick-up and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help haul a few boxes and the small dresser, but I’ll need to know the timing so I can plan the trip. Rey can sort the donations and keep an eye out for the drill, step ladder, and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll confirm the drop-off time and check whether you still need extra boxes. Thanks for helping with the haul.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana. Once you have the drop-off time, let me know and I’ll plan around it; if you end up finding extra boxes, I can take a few.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can bring screwdrivers and duct tape for the repair drive. Sounds like those are still needed, so I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great, Nell — I’ll keep an ear out for the drill, step ladder, or any extension cords while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep an ear out too, and I’ll bring the screwdrivers and duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I brought my screwdriver set and a roll of duct tape for the repair drive—hopefully that helps with whatever’s busted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s a big help, Oren. We’re still short on a few more screwdrivers, some spare screws, and maybe a couple rolls of duct tape, but Jules is checking the community center for the donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can look around my garage again in case I’ve got another screwdriver or some spare screws tucked away. If you need me to, I can bring whatever I find right over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re at 10 volunteers so far, and I’ve got Oren down for the 10 o’clock slot with his screwdriver set and duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Nice, that’s solid. I’ve got Pia and Noah helping haul boxes and the small dresser, and Dane’s bringing a hammer, screwdrivers, and spare nails.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great — we’re in good shape at 10 volunteers now. I’ll keep marking who can handle what and update the repair list as people arrive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’ll bring a hammer, screwdrivers, and some spare nails to the repair drive. Mara and Opal can keep the sign-ups and list organized, and Noah can grab anything we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll keep the sign-ups and list organized. With Jules checking the community center and Rosa and Ira spreading the word, we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll help out at the repair drive and bring the hammer, screwdrivers, and spare nails. If we’re missing anything, Noah can grab it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Mina and I are coordinating the repair drive, and I can help however you need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming, the repair drive is still at 9 at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that’s still right — 9 at the community center. Let me know if you need anything else for it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — Rey can handle the donations and tools, and I’ll keep the drop-off spot and timing clear for Kira and Dane.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m still gathering tools and parts, and Dane’s bringing a hammer, screwdrivers, and spare nails. Leo can help with the drive too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that keeps it tidy. Once you have the tools and parts sorted, let me know if the drop-off timing changes.
